status: Exploratory attribution of already evaluated experiment-specific heads; not biomarker validation
cohort: GSE298393 No E-stim Day21; reciprocal YA/OS training-pool heads, six held-out chips per head
primary: Training YA -> held-out OS; reverse pool direction for stability
target: Raw flight-vs-ground logit of frozen BridgeRNA mean+SD head; no encoder/head updates
method: Input Integrated Gradients, Gauss-Legendre8 vs16, adaptive32/64; fixed missing tokens
numerical_gate: sum IG matches logit difference within max(0.005,2% of absolute difference), L1 change <=5% at doubled quadrature; finite-difference gradient check
robustness: Top25/100 absolute attributed genes replaced by training-ground values vs20 expression/SD-matched random sets
Analytic expression-classifier attributions and matching random panel control
interpretation: Input evidence used by an experiment-specific classifier; not causal genes, independent samples, or calibrated radiation/gravity probabilities
